# GitHub Copilot instructions - SignalFlow Lab

This repository is built by an autonomous agent. Before doing any work:

1. Start at [BUILDER_KICKOFF.md](../BUILDER_KICKOFF.md) - it routes you to the
   current frontier, the living handoff, and the module authoring playbook.
2. Obey [AUTONOMY_CHARTER.md](../AUTONOMY_CHARTER.md) - it pre-answers decisions
   and defines the envelope for autonomous work. Frozen docs and validators may
   not be weakened, only extended.
3. Run `npm run check` before every commit and keep it green. Never weaken a
   check to make it pass.

Also honor the no-scroll HARD RULE for Exercise/workbench screens documented in
[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).
